items.title: Woman Pretended Child Died to Befriend Elderly Woman, Defrauded Her of $85K
items.summary:
A Vermont woman will serve prison time for defrauding an elderly woman she befriended and manipulated in a scheme to steal thousands of dollars from her, federal prosecutors said.

Chief U.S. District Judge Christina Reiss sentenced Jessica Russell , of Williamstown, to one year and eight months in prison on Friday, November 20, after she pleaded guilty to two federal counts of wire fraud, the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of Vermont said in a news release.

The judge also ordered Russell, 43, to pay nearly $85,000 in restitution to the victim’s family and imposed a $75,945.16 forfeiture money judgment, according to prosecutors.

The restitution figure, $84,420.16, reflects the amount of money Russell stole from the woman to buy herself a home and a car, prosecutors wrote in a sentencing memorandum obtained by Us .

Woman Accused of Spending Her Mom's 'Life Savings,' Locking Her in Bedroom 

Russell’s federal public defender, Sara M. Puls , didn’t immediately return a request for comment from Us .

Authorities discovered Russell financially took advantage of the woman, who has dementia, after firefighters found the woman “confused and injured, trapped in a filthy residence in Barton, Vermont” during extensive flooding in 2023, the U.S. Attorney’s Office said in its release.

Russell later admitted as part of her plea agreement that she befriended the woman between the summer of 2013 and July 2023, partly by pretending her child had died, as the woman had experienced the death of her own child, according to prosecutors.

She allegedly lied to the woman to endear…
items.t: Woman Pretended Child Died to Befriend Elderly Woman, Defrauded Her of $85K

items.title: Christina Applegate Fires Back at Trolls After MS Misdiagnosis
items.summary:
Christina Applegate is clapping back at trolls who criticized her for being disappointed that she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis.

“I don’t want to sit here and be like, ‘Boo-hoo-hoo me’ all the time about this whole thing because now it’s about kind of getting boots on the ground now and getting myself together,” Applegate, 54, said during the Tuesday, November 24, episode of her and Jamie Lynn Sigler ’s “MeSsy” podcast. “It really does feel good to feel understood because it’s a hard thing to come out and say that I’m upset that I don’t have MS, right?”

Addressing her critics, the Dead to Me alum continued, “A lot of people had a lot to f***ing say about it after I came out. But, you know, it’s not about that. It’s about an identity thing. … It’s about a community that I love still, as we know.”

Applegate also pointed out that having a diagnosis allowed her to “relax” into her illness rather than constantly searching for answers about what’s wrong with her health.

Why Christina Applegate Is Not ‘Happy’ About No Longer Having MS 

“It can be incredibly stressful,” she added.

Applegate first announced her battle with what she believed to be MS in 2021. After five years of detailing her health journey and advocating for MS patients, the actress revealed in October that she had been misdiagnosed with the autoimmune disorder.

“[My doctor] came into my room and said, ‘Congratulations, you don’t have MS,’” she said on her podcast at the time. “I was, like, not happy at all. Everybody else was so happy.”

Applegate became emotional as she explained, “You don’t get…

items.title: Former Teacher Arrested for Holding Baby After Sexting Underage Student
items.summary:
A former teacher in Kentucky was arrested for a second time after she allegedly violated her bond conditions by holding a newborn baby.

Rachel Clement ’s bond was revoked on Monday, November 23, after prosecutors learned of the incident. Clement was arrested for a second time after she held the 2-week-old child when she went to a church that is attached to a school on November 13 to drop off birthday party decorations.

Clement previously pleaded guilty to two counts of sexual abuse and one count of evidence tampering in October after she was caught having a sexual relationship with a student at Henderson High School in Henderson, Kentucky, according to The Hendersonian .

As part of her plea deal, Clement, 29, registered as a sex offender, was barred from school premises and was prohibited from having contact with minors except for her biological niece, according to the outlet.

1st Grade Teacher in Tennessee Charged With Abuse of Her Own 2 Kids 

Following her second arrest, Clement’s attorney, Jonathan Coomes , argued that his client was at the church at the pastor’s request. He also told the outlet that she had no contact with school-age children and that she left the premises before students arrived.

Coomes went on to argue that the child that Clement held was “not similar in characteristics to the victim in the present case,” noting that her victim was a teenager. It is not currently clear if Clement had a relation to the child in question.

Clement is facing up to three years in prison on each sexual abuse charge and five years for evidence tampering. She is…
items.t: Former Teacher Arrested for Holding Baby After Sexting Underage Student

Nearly five years after Boston police officer John O’Keefe died, his teenage niece revealed how she believes his then-girlfriend, Karen Read , was involved in his death.

While appearing in Netflix’s November docuseries The Trials of Karen Read , O’Keefe’s niece Kayley Furbush explained that she and her younger brother spent several years living with O’Keefe, 46, after their parents died within months of each other.

“I think Karen knew what had happened, that maybe she had done something to JJ and she didn’t want [it] to almost, like, be a reality,” Furbush said of her uncle’s death. “Or after that, not wanting to believe what she, like, knows is true in her head.”

After O’Keefe died in January 2022, Read, 46, was arrested for his murder when she was accused of hitting him with her car.

Who Is Michael Proctor? Former Officer Named in Karen Read's Lawsuit 

During the high-profile trials, prosecutors argued that Read backed her SUV into O’Keefe and left him in the snow while she was under the influence of alcohol. Meanwhile, Read’s defense claimed he was killed inside of his friend’s house and that she was framed for his murder.

Read’s first trial ended in a mistrial in 2024. She returned to court in 2025 and was eventually acquitted of second-degree murder , manslaughter while operating under the influence and leaving the scene of a collision resulting in death in June of that year.

Despite the major legal victories, Read was found guilty of operating a motor vehicle under the influence of liquor.

James told deputies Dean and Catic left the home and “didn’t know where they had gone,” according to the sheriff’s office.

Sheila died from gynecological cancer and was hospitalized for four days prior to her death, interpreter Aimee Adiwang told Page Six on Tuesday, November 24.

According to Aimee, Sheila was initially under the impression that she had a urinary tract infection (UTI) because that’s what doctors had determined.

Sheila’s teen son, Jhonreil , allegedly told Aimee that his mom was also “severely anemic” and experienced “circulatory failure” leading up to her death.

Sheila, who appeared alongside Aimee and former fiancé David Dangerfield on TLC’s 90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days , died in the Philippines, according to a statement shared by David via Instagram on Sunday, November 22.

“I am devastated and still trying to process this loss. Please keep her son, her family, and me in your prayers,” he added. “Thank you for all your love and support.”

Sheila’s sister, Grace Mangubat , also remembered her beloved sibling in a Facebook tribute, writing, “Rest in peace my beloved sister, Shiela [sic] Mangubat … fly high my sister, we will miss you.”

'90 Day Fiance' Tragedies: The Saddest and Most Shocking Deaths 

That same day, Sheila’s brother, Jonathan Mangubat , shared a video from his late sister’s funeral via his Facebook Stories, reportedly showing her in an open casket wearing all white. Hours before she died, he documented the family’s final moments by her side.

Sheila is survived by her only son, Jhonreil .

items.t: '90 Day Fiance' Alum Sheila Mangubat's Cause of Death Revealed

items.title: Anthem Singer Reacts After 'O Canada' Flub at NHL Game: 'I Botched the Lyrics'
items.summary:
National anthem singer Sarrah Strimel Bentley responded after flubbing the lyrics to “O Canada” before a game between the Toronto Maple Leafs and New York Islanders on Monday, November 23.  

“I sang both anthems, and I just wanted to apologize to all of my Canadians,” Bentley, 45 , said in a video posted via Instagram shortly after the viral moment. “Because I practiced the s***‘ out of ‘O Canada,’ and getting up in front of 18,000 people, singing an anthem that you haven’t heard for your whole life is scary, and I botched the lyrics, and I’m really sorry.” 

Bentley, a Broadway performer who has appeared in “An American in Paris,” “Rock of Ages” and “The Producers,” performed both the Canadian and American national anthems on the Islanders’ Hockey Fights Cancer night. The singer is a breast cancer survivor herself.  

“I got put in menopause because I had breast cancer, and tonight is about hockey fighting cancer, and menopause makes you forget things,” she explained. “So, I just wish that you’d be a little easier on someone who’s just a human being. And I’m sorry.” 

Missing Coach Travis Turner's Wife Addresses His Disappearance 1-Year Later 

Bentley twice sang “We lend our hearts to thee” instead of “We stand on guard for thee,” which drew a confused reaction from Maple Leafs captain Auston Matthews .  

“Thank you for giving me grace,” Bentley concluded her apology. “I love Canada. I stand on guard for thee.” 

The Islanders issued a statement after the performance, shining a light on Bentley’s cancer battle.  

“For Hockey Fights Cancer Night, the Islanders invited…
items.t: Anthem Singer Reacts After 'O Canada' Flub at NHL Game: 'I Botched the Lyrics'

items.title: Elementary School Teacher Arrested for Alleged Possession of Child Pornography
items.summary:
A community in Texas was left in shock after an elementary school teacher was arrested for allegedly possessing child pornography.

On Friday, November 20, physical education teacher Bryan Rasco was booked on three felony charges of possession of child pornography.

Authorities learned of the allegations against Rasco, 58, when Amazon flagged files that were uploaded to an Amazon Photos account earlier this year, according to an arrest affidavit viewed by Us . Rasco possessed or accessed the files with intent to view child sexual abuse material on or about May 3, according to the complaint.

The lead investigator in the case was assigned to look over tips that the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children made available to the Houston Metro Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force on May 6. Investigators then used records to link Rasco to the account.

On November 9, the lead investigator contacted a Conroe ISD police detective, who confirmed that Rasco worked for the district.

Investigators are still working to identify Rasco’s potential victims. However, the Montgomery County Precinct 1 Constable’s Office said that authorities currently do not believe any of Rasco’s alleged offenses took place on school property.

Following Rasco’s arrest, Conroe ISD’s Executive Director of Communications Andrew Stewart told Fox 26 that the school district “first learned of the investigation” on Friday morning.

items.title: Rob Lowe's Most Candid Quotes About His Infamous Sex Tape Scandal
items.summary:
Rob Lowe made major changes to his life after his sex tape was leaked in the ’80s — but what has he said about the scandal?

Lowe’s star was on the rise after his roles in Thursday’s Child, The Outsiders, St. Elmo’s Fire and About Last Night . The actor was campaigning for Michael Dukakis in the 1988 presidential election when a sex tape was leaked showing Lowe with two people: 22-year-old Tara Seburt and her 16-year-old friend Lena Jan Parsons .

At the time, the age of consent in Atlanta, where the video was filmed, was 14. Both girls were of legal age to engage in sexual activity, but 18 was the legal age to be involved in recording. Lowe, for his part, maintained that he thought Parsons was 21 because they met at a nightclub before the encounter.

The footage went on to become one of the first-ever commercially released celebrity sex tapes. Lowe, meanwhile, settled a lawsuit with Parsons. family out of court and was not charged with a crime. His career took a hit, and he battled alcohol addiction for several years before getting sober in 1990.

Rob Lowe Through the Years: The Brat Pack Era and More 

Lowe, who has since poked fun at himself by mentioning the drama in a Saturday Night Live monologue, has credited his wife, Sheryl Berkoff , for helping him get to a better place. The couple tied the knot in 1991 and expanded their family twice with sons Matthew and John.

After bouncing back, Lowe went on to appear in The West Wing, Brothers & Sisters, Parks and Recreation, Code Black and 9-1-1: Lone Star . Over the years, he has also made rare comments about the sex…
items.t: Rob Lowe's Most Candid Quotes About His Infamous Sex Tape Scandal

items.title: Kristin Cavallari Announces She's Leaving Her Podcast: 'It's Been a Journey'
items.summary:
Kristin Cavallari is closing the book on her “ Let’s Be Honest ” podcast.

“I’m getting emotional, you guys. I have an announcement, and I’m not gonna cry because this is not the end yet. But I am leaving the podcast,” the Hills alum, 39, said during the Tuesday, November 24, episode. “I did not plan on getting emotional. I am so incredibly grateful that I have had this opportunity and that I’ve been able to connect with you guys on such a real, deep level, and I feel like I’ve been able to finally show people who I really am after being on reality TV for so long and always feeling like I’ve been misunderstood.”

Cavallari added that she feels like she has “gotten to say everything I’ve wanted to say” in the last three years of her podcast.

“It’s been a really fun, wild ride. Like, when I started the podcast, I was actively dating and I was newly single, and it was really fun, all my dating stories. It’s been a journey, and I’ve been so happy to have you guys on this ride with me,” she continued.

Why Kristin Cavallari No Longer Wants to Be on Reality TV After Tour Show 

Cavallari admitted that the downside of her podcast has been “having to be out there every single week.”

“There would be headlines all the time about the podcast, and I don’t like that stuff,” she explained. ”But in the past, if I was in pop culture a lot, I could reel it in, right? I could go silent on socials. I could not do any interviews. I could stop doing everything. I don’t have that luxury with this podcast to be quiet when I want to be quiet.”

items.t: Kristin Cavallari Announces She's Leaving Her Podcast: 'It's Been a Journey'

items.title: Bella Hadid Details 'Intense' Desire to Have 'Lots of Children'
items.summary:
Bella Hadid is opening up about her hopes to have children after making her romance with Nathan Lacy Instagram official.

“Success, for me, can be living in peace, in a small town, with a man that I love, with my child, having my animals,” Hadid, 30, told Harper’s Bazaar in an interview published on Monday, November 23.

The supermodel shared with the magazine that she also has goals that don’t involve walking the runway, including operating a local small business, learning hobbies and getting married and becoming a mother.

“I’ve always wanted to start a farm-to-table bakery, with flowers, and everything comes from the community. I want to do things that are fulfilling for me in my soul: having a greenhouse that I can garden in, having my glassblowing and ceramic studio, and having lots of children and being a mother,” she said. “It wasn’t a dream that I’ve always had, but it’s something that now is so intense for me. My intuition is screaming so loudly at me about it.”

A Comprehensive Guide to the Hadid Family: Gigi and Bella, More 

Days prior, Hadid went Instagram official with Lacy by sharing a series of photos from their outing to a Colorado Avalanche game.

“Let’s go Avs!!!!!! 🏒 Saturday night was especially meaningful. 🫶Honoring Hockey Fights Cancer. Thank you @coloradoavalanche for using the power of sport for something so much bigger than the scoreboard,” Hadid wrote on November 7.
